fixed_selection_rule: Official YCB VAL strict_external_corroborated_5x5==1 and saved MIXED exact logical state V or O. For each predicted state, choose first2 rows in scene8 with different object_id and different frame, plus first row in scene9, sorted lexicographic sample_id. No probability ranking. Qualitative6-case sheet, not a representative sample.
strict_external: Full target support and no target visible in all25 native in-frame pixels, with other annotated visible support at all25; annotation proxy remains uncertain physically.
inputs: Only preserved public source RGB/masks/box metadata and already saved v64 source model outputs. No model inference, GPU, private/current data, training or PnP.
global_view: Source locked SAM promptbox expanded1.25 about its center in each axis, RGB crop. Roughbox is annotation-derived public source jitter; no new mask-fitted crop. Display original roughbox and query. Separate colored official full/visible overlay is diagnostic evidence, never an input image.
support_colors: green=target visible; magenta=target full minus visible proxy; query marker yellow
diagnostic_questions: Does the global RGB reveal enough target-specific shape to distinguish the conditioned target from the foreground object?
Does a large visible portion of the target remain inside the rough crop?
Does the target's visible shape plausibly constrain hidden full support at this query, or does that require unobserved3D shape/pose?
Would target box/image ownership resolve an apparent local texture confusion, while exact hidden support remains ambiguous?
limits: RGB global shape may improve target identity but cannot certify amodal membership behind occluders. Model errors V and O respectively concern visibility and full support, so improvements must be measured separately with unchanged6-joint source labels. Source visual judgments are hypotheses, not proof a proposed encoder will solve them.
